verdict.rationale: Mercury exposes an Events/Webhooks API for reacting to account events (mercury-docs-13) and community evidence confirms real-world use of auto-funding rules across accounts and auto-deposited cashback (mercury-comm-1, mercury-docs-8), plus auto-attaching receipts to transactions (mercury-docs-5/28) and AI-driven bookkeeping automations (mercury-docs-6). However these are largely built-in, fixed automations rather than a general user-defined 'if event X then action Y' rules engine, and triggering actions still requires external code consuming webhooks since the MCP server is read-only (mercury-probe-5). Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose rules/automation builder UI, explicit support for arbitrary custom triggers→actions, and any write-capable AI/agent interface for automated actions.
